title: Monarch Butterfly Numbers Have Collapsed Since The 1990s
hook: Your garden vanished 94% of monarch milkweed
closing: No milkweed, no monarchs. It's really that simple.
question: When did you last see a monarch?

segments.say: By 2024, the monarchs' winter forest habitat had shrunk to just 0.9 hectares, a sliver of what it once was.
By 2014, 94 percent of soybeans were herbicide-resistant, wiping out the milkweed monarchs need to survive.
The western monarch migration alone has collapsed 95 percent since the 1980s.
